title: CDC milestone pages are not a developmental screening tool
summary: The CDC says its Learn the Signs materials are not a substitute for standardized, validated developmental screening tools.
body: The CDC's nine-month milestone page says: "Learn the Signs. Act Early." materials are not a substitute for standardized, validated developmental screening tools. A family checklist is not the validated screen that sentence names. The page is public US health information. It does not diagnose a child. A family checklist is not that validated tool and does not diagnose a child.

sources.title: Milestones by 9 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US CDC page, public domain. Updated and reviewed 16 May 2026. Short public-domain quotation of the screening-tool limit. That sentence is the claim.
